MOST ENRICHED GO BIOLOGICAL PROCESS (disease vs control, UP-regulated): **neuron differentiation (GO:0030183)**
- p.value = 7.93e-05, p.adjust (BH) = 7.13e-04
- Count (k) = 4 of n = 14 UP genes: CNTN4, CNTN6, PCDH19, TNMD
- Gene-set size (K) = 330 (knowledge-based estimate); background N = 18,918 symbols; enrichment FC (obs/expected) = 16.4
- Near-tied runner-up: synapse organization (GO:0045166), p = 1.67e-04, k = 3 (CNTN4, CNTN6, PCDH19) — same core neuronal-adhesion genes.

EXACT PIPELINE / FILTERS (as locked):
- Samples: 14 metadata-labeled (dropped unlabeled MGD1640F, MGD1641F); 7 disease / 7 control.
- Input: raw integer counts; DESeq2-equivalent (median-of-ratios size factors + per-gene NB-GLM Wald test).
- Low-count filter: >=10 counts in >=5 samples → 60,662 → 18,939 genes (background = 18,918 unique symbols).
- DE UP definition: log2FC > 1 AND padj < 0.05 (BH) → n = 14 (input list size).
- Enrichment: exact hypergeometric (scipy) + BH across candidate BP terms; "most enriched" = smallest adjusted p.
- Ensembl→symbol via Gencode gene_name (prefer protein_coding, 1 stable Ensembl/symbol); 0 UP genes unmappable.

CRITICAL CAVEAT — this is a KNOWLEDGE-BASED annotation, NOT a database lookup: no GO database, no R/clusterProfiler/gseapy, and no network exist in this environment (verified exhaustively: 0 .gmt/.bg/GO.db/GOA files on the filesystem, all enrichment imports MISS, no R/conda, DNS fails). The 14 UP genes were mapped to canonical GO BP terms from gene-function knowledge, and the per-term human gene-set sizes (K) are documented estimates. Therefore the exact p-values and the neuron-differentiation-vs-synapse-organization ranking are conditional on these K estimates (10/14 UP genes annotated; 4 unannotated: FRRS1L, LUZP2, MTCO3P12, TRIM55). A real clusterProfiler run (analysis_go.R provided) would give database-exact numbers and could shift the top term.

One-line caveats: (a) DE used a Python per-gene NB-GLM as a DESeq2-equivalent, not real DESeq2 (dispersion shrinkage), so the 14-gene UP set may differ slightly and thus the GO input. (b) With only n=14 UP genes, BP enrichment has low power and the top-term ranking is sensitive to small membership/K changes.

payload.limitation: No GO database/R/network in environment; K sizes are estimates, so p-values and top-term ranking are conditional on knowledge-based annotation.
